summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an Agreement of Purchase and Sale for the Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort & Spa in Avon, Colorado. The sale price is $176 million in cash, with close expected in Q2 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds will redeem outstanding 4.50% Convertible Senior Notes due June 2026 and fund general corporate purposes. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnities. Watch for closing conditions and use of proceeds; risk-arb centers on timely satisfaction of conditions and potential note redemption impact.
